[[Fanfare (Tatooine) (V) (Errata)]]: Players Committee card image as published 14 May 2020, from the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b2c2653/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/fanfaretatooine.gif fanfaretatooine.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b2c2653 b2c2653].

Edits: none. The image is uploaded unchanged.

The same commit published the same bytes as <code>ResetDS-Dark/large/fanfare.gif</code> (same commit <code>b2c2653</code>, SHA-1 <code>c48569cf8746cf32b71202522dd107c3090c17cf</code> for both), so this image is also the card image of [[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]]. On this wiki it is shown on [[Fanfare (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/21/VD-D-fanfare-2020-05-14.gif Internet Archive item].
